label: The scorecard's recall check slices the pane at the last session-handover marker or the whole pane when none exists, so a pane without a marker passes on the sender's own prompt echo.
The Pi pane has no session-handover marker, so its afterSeed is the whole 30172-character capture and the side word appears at character 12812 inside the echoed sender prompt.
The OpenCode pane's last marker sits at character 425, so its side word is genuinely in the receiver's reply and its recall is real.
The Pi receiver's own words contradict its scorecard: it said a fresh session has no path to the side word, not through the note and not through history lookup.
The Pi 4/5 is the noteClosed step, not the recall block: the note stayed claimed because the receiver held the close open waiting for the operator, and recall is scored apart from the five steps.
The harness plants no token: live-hop.sh contains no token, REDACT or plant reference, so the REDACTED completion criterion has no evidence from either run.

The carry block reports unobservable when the first launch line's basename equals the runtime and the line is exactly the runtime name, which is the Pi case, so Pi's carry can never be scored from the card.
